notes: gt* tables are the client's rating tables, one float per class and level (row index = (class-1)*100 + level-1; tables with 11 rows are per class only). gtChanceToMeleeCrit / SpellCrit: 1 / value = agility (intellect for spells) needed for 1% crit. *CritBase: base crit % per class. gtRegenHPPerSpt / MPPerSpt: regen per tick per spirit point; gtOCTRegenHP / MP: out-of-combat regen per class and level.
